philosophy.title:
We do more than deliver.
We get involved.

zaffiro.name: Zaffiro
zaffiro.tagline: The value of water, well managed.
zaffiro.description: Zaffiro is the water-resource management platform for ASADAS. It centralizes operation, billing, water quality, and the pipe network of the community aqueduct.
zaffiro.problem: Running an ASADA means handling large amounts of information spread across spreadsheets, documents, receipts, and separate systems.
zaffiro.value: Zaffiro gathers that information in a specialized, accessible, and reliable platform, so managing water is simpler, clearer, and more efficient.
zaffiro.focus1: Subscribers, meters, and a GIS map of the network.
zaffiro.focus2: Billing, collection, and water quality: chlorine, flow, and the IANC index.
zaffiro.focus3: Payroll, accounting, inventory, and community messaging.
zaffiro.benefit1: More clarity, more control, and better decisions.
zaffiro.benefit2: Commercial, technical, and financial work in one place.
zaffiro.benefit3: Support, data migration, and training in Costa Rica.
zaffiro.audience: ASADAS and organizations that run community aqueducts in Costa Rica.
zaffiro.hook: Spreadsheets, receipts, and systems that do not talk to each other.
zaffiro.invite: See the water when everything lives in one place.
zaffiro.riverAlt: A clear river running through vegetation.

kizvna.name: KIZVNA
kizvna.tagline: From an idea to a story that connects: social content, campaigns, music, fashion, and creative culture.
kizvna.description: A creative universe for audiovisual production, social content, campaigns, music, creators, training, photography, and editorial fashion.

identity.workBody: KIZVNA produces the content through which a brand, an artist, or a person lets itself be seen.
identity.heroLead: We make the image, the sound, and the campaign of a project so it feels true.
identity.heroBody: If the work has to be seen, heard, or worn, it is produced here. We do not invent a life to make the piece impressive. We work with what the brand is.
identity.work1Body: Music and image produced as one piece: the track, the video, and the atmosphere that holds them together.
identity.work2Body: The still image of a brand, a person, or a campaign. What remains when the video stops.
identity.work3Body: The idea and the piece with which a brand introduces itself, made to be remembered rather than to look like everyone else.
identity.work4Body: Spots that explain an offer clearly. The product is shown as it is.
identity.work5Body: The garment, the person wearing it, and the visual world it lives in. Fashion treated as image, not as a catalog.
identity.trustTitle: A project stays where it is looked after.
identity.trustBody: Trust is not announced. It shows in the piece. We do not invent a story to make yours look bigger. We work with what you already are, and that is what gets seen, heard, and remembered.
identity.kofahLine: Remember, learn, move forward. That is how we greet, and how we close a job.
identity.inviteBody: Tell us what you want seen, heard, or worn. We read it as the start of a piece, not as another form.
identity.image0Alt: A dark studio seen from the doorway, with a warm band of light across the floor.
identity.image1Alt: Hands on a console, with a microphone switched on, in a booth that is in use.
identity.image2Alt: A camera in hand, and a light being set into place.
identity.image3Alt: A set being built: hands on a cyclorama, with light stands nearby.
identity.image4Alt: Hands placing a plain object in the light, with no packaging and no brand.
identity.image5Alt: Hands adjusting a garment with pins on a dress form.
identity.image6Alt: Printed photographs on a dark table, with a pencil.
identity.role1Body: Someone in the booth, until the track and the image are the same piece.
identity.role2Body: Someone who knows how a person lets themself be seen, without inventing a life for them.
identity.role2Alt: Someone seen from behind, filming with a phone in front of a ring light.
identity.role3Body: Someone who looks after what is understood first, and what is remembered.
identity.role3Alt: Printed frames laid in a row on a table, beside a phone and a pencil.
identity.role4Body: Someone who thinks about the garment, the person wearing it, and the world it lives in.
identity.originBody: KIZVNA begins as a visual reinterpretation of the Japanese word Kizuna — 絆, the bond between people. Replacing the U with a V turns that word into an identity of its own: KIZUNA becomes KIZVNA. The essence stays. The idea of union becomes a symbol.
identity.originClose: KIZVNA stands for different people, with different stories, joined by something larger than themselves.
identity.bondBody: It stands for the bond: with family, with those who were there from the beginning, with history, between artists, with people who recognize themselves in the music, and with the places we come from. Also with people who lived completely different realities and share the same principles.
identity.bondClose: Where you come from is not what matters. What matters is who you are, what you stand for, and how you walk with others.
identity.kofahBody: KOFAH is the group's greeting and farewell. It draws on Sankofa, an Akan principle from Ghana: moving forward does not mean forgetting where we come from. It is not a traditional Akan word, and it is not a literal translation of Sankofa.
identity.kofahMeaning: Inside KIZVNA, KOFAH means remember, learn, and move forward. KIZVNA is the bond, the people who walk together. KOFAH is memory and the path, what we carry while we walk.
identity.greeting: On meeting: I remember who I am, I recognize who walks with me, we keep going.
identity.farewell: On parting: do not forget where you come from, keep going, we will meet again on the path.
identity.missionBody: To create honest music projects that give voice, space, and representation to talent born where people often are not looking. Music is understood as a family and as a way to transform one's own history. Origin does not set the limit.
identity.visionBody: To be a music movement where people of different origins, stories, and realities can create, grow, and be represented with authenticity. A family of artists faithful to who they are, using music as expression, connection, and transformation, and opening space for real voices no matter where they come from.
identity.philosophyBody: KIZVNA was not born only to make music. It was born to make connections. Different people can have lived completely different realities and still recognize themselves in the same values. The same story is not required to walk in the same direction.
identity.value1Body: Never forget who you are or where you come from. Growth does not place anyone above anyone else.
identity.value2Body: Continue even when the results have not appeared yet. Falling does not mean it is over.
identity.value3Body: Remember who was there when there was still nothing. Values are not left behind when better opportunities appear.
identity.value4Body: KIZVNA is not only trying to create artists. It is trying to build bonds. Family can also be made.
identity.value5Body: A story does not need to be invented for it to have worth. Credibility comes from that honesty.
identity.value6Body: Some principles do not change depending on who is standing in front of you. Listening does not mean bending.
identity.value7Body: Once the destination is set, the work continues until it is reached. Opportunities are also created.
identity.value8Body: Being real means not playing a character in order to belong. What is authentic weighs more than what is manufactured.
identity.value9Body: Make room for stories that deserve to be heard. KIZVNA does not belong to a single class, neighborhood, country, or culture.
identity.value10Body: This revenge is not aimed at people. It is aimed at circumstances, prejudice, and the limits that once seemed to decide how far someone could go.
identity.code8: Stand for something larger than yourself.
identity.code9: Let every achievement be a revenge against your circumstances.
identity.revengeBody: The revenge is to build, create, grow, represent, and open doors. Then keep those doors open for the people who come after. Success is our revenge: not against people, but against circumstances, prejudice, and limits.

vytal.name: Vytal
vytal.tagline: Technology for nutrition, wellbeing, and professional follow-up.
vytal.category: Technology for nutrition, wellbeing, and professional follow-up.
vytal.description: A platform that connects nutrition and wellbeing professionals with the people they advise, bringing plans, progress, follow-up, and communication into one ongoing digital experience.
vytal.problem: Follow-up between a professional and the person they advise is often split across messages, files, and notes that never become a continuous record.
vytal.value: Vytal aims to hold the plan, the progress, and the conversation in an experience that stays with the professional relationship over time.
vytal.focus3: Updated plans and communication between the professional and the person they advise.
vytal.benefit1: A more continuous relationship of support.
vytal.benefit2: The person's context available when it is needed.
vytal.benefit3: Less dependence on scattered channels to keep the plan going.
vytal.audience: Nutrition and wellbeing professionals, and the people they support.
vytal.hook: The plan is there. The thread of the conversation is not.
vytal.invite: If you guide someone through nutrition, tell us how you hold that thread today.

dyniq.name: Dyniq
dyniq.tagline: More customers, more sales, and a team with time for what matters.
dyniq.description: Dyniq puts AI agents to work answering your customers by voice and by chat, at any hour, so no opportunity is lost.
dyniq.problem: Someone who writes or calls and gets no answer goes to another business. The enquiry stays a loose message, and the team repeats the same work.
dyniq.value: Dyniq answers by voice and by chat so an enquiry can end as an appointment, an order, or a lead, and the team keeps its time for what needs a person.
dyniq.focus1: Phone calls, WhatsApp, website, on-site widget, SMS, and Instagram.
dyniq.focus2: An enquiry can end as an appointment, an order, or a lead.
dyniq.focus3: The agent says it is a virtual assistant. You decide what it does and when a person steps in.
dyniq.benefit1: An answer right away, at any hour.
dyniq.benefit2: Whoever already bought hears from the business again and is recognized when they write or call.
dyniq.benefit3: You pay for what you use.
dyniq.audience: Businesses that serve customers by phone, chat, and social channels.
dyniq.hook: Who answers when no one is there?
dyniq.invite: See an agent answer by voice and by chat.

about.metaDescription: The story, philosophy, mission, and values of Merakai Studio.
about.title: We put soul into the work.
about.originBody: Merakai comes from meraki, the Greek idea of putting soul, passion, and dedication into what you make. The studio pairs that attitude with creativity, strategy, and technology.
about.purpose: Today we return to our roots with a clear purpose: to give our communities back the knowledge the world gave us.
about.philosophyBody: We do not separate form from substance. A brand, a product, and a system have to hold each other up.
about.missionBody: We turn ideas into brands, strategy into results, and technology into growth.
about.visionBody: To build a technology studio with an international presence and an ecosystem of its own products.
about.capabilitiesBody: We develop software, design products, build brands, set strategy, produce content, and advise on technology decisions.
about.ecosystemBody: Alongside work for others, Merakai Studio creates and looks after its own products. Zaffiro is the water-management platform for ASADAS, with its official landing at zaffiro.app. Dyniq answers with AI agents by voice and by chat, with its official landing at dyniq-ai.com. Vytal is in development. KIZVNA is the audiovisual content brand: music and video production, photography, advertising, commercials, and fashion.
